title: First free flight of humans in a hot air balloon
summary: Pilatre de Rozier and the Marquis d'Arlandes flew a Montgolfier hot air balloon over Paris for about 25 minutes.
reason: The Montgolfier brothers had shown that heated air could lift a balloon and wanted to prove humans could fly safely.
significance: It was the first human flight.
place: Chateau de la Muette, Paris, France
